This allows us to provide the services and features that are most likely to meet your needs, and customize our Platform to make your experience much safer and easier. Most importantly, we only collect personal information from you that we consider is necessary to achieve this purpose.

Once you give us your personal information, you are no longer anonymous to us. You always have the option to not provide specific information by choosing not to use a particular service or feature on our platform.

We use this information to do internal research for our users' demographics, interests, and behavior to better understand, protect and serve our users. This information is compiled and analyzed on an aggregated basis. This information may include the URL that you just visited from (whether this URL is from our platform or not), which URL you go to next (whether this URL is from our platform or not), your computer browser information, and your IP address.
sum_acc_private_policy.we_use_data_collection_devices: We use data collection devices such as "cookies" on certain pages from our platform to analyze our web traffic flow, measure promotional effectiveness, and promote trust and safety. "Cookies" are small files that were placed on your hard drive which assist us to provide you services. There are certain features that are only available through the use of a "cookie". We also use cookies to reduce the frequency for you to enter your password during a session. Cookies can also help us to provide information that is targeted to your interests. Most cookies are "session cookies," meaning they are automatically deleted from your hard drive at the end of a session. You can reject our cookies at any time when your browser provides you with the option. In this case, you may not be able to use certain features on our platform and you may be required to reenter your password more frequently during a session.
sum_acc_private_policy.you_may_encounter: Additionally, you may encounter "cookies" or other similar devices placed by third parties on certain pages of our platform. For example, if you are viewing a web page that was created by a user, there may be a "cookie" placed within that web page. We do not control the use of cookies by third parties.

sum_acc_private_policy.if_you_establish: When you establish a payment method with us to pay the fees that we charge, our platform will collect some additional information, such as a billing address, a credit/ debit card number and a credit/ debit card expiration date and/ or other payment instrument details and tracking information from checks or money orders.

reward.estimators_paragraph_heading1: Skill Reward Distribution Rules for Estimators
reward.estimators_paragraph_heading2: Collect Estimators Skill Rewards from Sealed Bid Auctions
reward.estimators_paragraph1: What is an 'Estimator'? 'Estimators' are essentially Bynfor users who have used the 'Estimate Price' feature on any auction listing, and have left their estimates and comments on the items being auctioned off.
reward.estimators_paragraph2: Eligible listing 'Estimators' can be awarded a total 1.5% of the winning bid amount split up between eligible entries. In order to collect the prize, the 'Estimator' must have received at least one like from the winning bidder and therefore would receive 0.5% automatically.
reward.estimators_paragraph3: The other scenario is that of 'Estimators' who received at least one like from a bidder, who is neither the winning bidder nor the lowest bidder, are also eligible to collect Skill Rewards up to 0.5% (allocated randomly) of winning bid amount as additional membership benefit.
reward.estimators_paragraph4: If the lowest bidder in the auction liked the Estimation, then the 'Estimator' who left it will not be eligible for Skill Reward. If there is an equal amount of likes from bidders and there is a tie between two Estimators, then the 'Estimator' with a higher membership package will get priority and hence win the 'Skill Reward'. If both of those Estimators have the same membership package, then whoever registered to Bynfor first will get priority and hance the 'Skill Reward'. If no bidder liked any Estimations put forth by the 'Estimators', then all Estimator Skill Reward for that auction goes to the 'Skill Reward Foundation' and will then be randomly given away at the end of each week to eligible users.
reward.estimators_paragraph5: If there is not enough 'Skill Rewards' available for distribution for that particular listing, then we will give the eligible participants $0.01 from the Skill Reward Foundation.
reward.estimators_paragraph6: An estimator's price is closest to the final price(best estimator), then the estimator will receive 0.5% of the winning bid amount automatically (the estimator with like from winning bidder and best estimator could be the same person).
reward.commentors_paragraph_heading1: Skill Reward Distribution Rules for Commenters
reward.commentors_paragraph1: What is a 'Commenter'? A 'Commenter' is simply a user who has left a comment on another user's auction listing. It's as simple as that. Make a good comment and wait until someone likes what you wrote. As soon as they do, you are eligible.
reward.commentors_paragraph2: Eligible 'Commenters' can be rewarded a total 0.5% of the winning bid amount for the listing commented on. A 'Commenter' who has received at least one like from the winning bidder will receive 0.3% automatically.
reward.commentors_paragraph3: Eligible 'Commenters' who receive at least one like from a bidder, who are neither the winning bidder nor the lowest bidder, would be eligible to collect 'Skill Rewards' amount of 0.2% (allocated randomly) of winning bid amount (as an additional members only benefit).
reward.commentors_paragraph4: If no bidder liked any of the comments, then all Commenter Skill Reward for that auction goes to the 'Skill Reward Foundation' for distribution later. If the lowest bidder likes a Comment, then the commenter will not be eligible for 'Skill Rewards'.
reward.commentors_paragraph5: If there is an equal amount of likes from bidders and there is a tie between two 'Commenters', then the 'Commenter' with a higher membership package will get priority and hence win the 'Skill Reward'. If both of those 'Commentors' have the same membership package, then whoever registered to Bynfor first will get priority and hence the 'Skill Reward'. If no bidder liked any comments put forth by the 'Commentors', then all Skill Rewards for that auction goes to the 'Skill Reward Foundation' and will then be randomly given away at the end of each week to eligible users.
reward.commentors_paragraph6: If there is not enough 'Skill Rewards' available for distribution for that particular listing, then we will give the eligible participants $0.01 from the Skill Reward Foundation.
reward.translators_paragraph_heading1: Skill Reward Distribution Rules for Translators
reward.translators_paragraph_heading2: Collect Translator Skill Rewards from Sealed Bid Auctions
reward.translators_paragraph1: What is a 'Translator' on the Bynfor platform? A 'Translator' is a user who translates any of the Bynfor listings into one of the other required languages available in the list and receives likes from the community, in essence validating the quality of the transaltion.
reward.translators_paragraph2: Eligible 'Translators' can be rewarded a total 0.2% of the winning bid amount for the listing translated on. A 'Translator' who has received at least one like from the winning bidder will receive 0.12% automatically.
reward.translators_paragraph3: Eligible 'Translators' who receive at least one like from a bidder, who are neither the winning bidder nor the lowest bidder, would be eligible to collect 'Skill Rewards' amount of 0.08% (allocated randomly) of winning bid amount (as an additional members only benefit).
reward.translators_paragraph4: If no bidder liked any of the translations, then all Translator Skill Rewards for that auction listing goes to the 'Skill Reward Foundation' for distribution later. If the lowest bidder likes a translation, then the translator will not be eligible for 'Skill Rewards'.
reward.translators_paragraph5: If there is an equal amount of likes from bidders and there is a tie between two 'Translators', then the 'Translator' with a higher membership package will get priority and hence win the 'Skill Reward'. If both of those 'Translators' have the same membership package, then whoever registered to Bynfor first will get priority and hence the 'Skill Reward'. If no bidder liked any comments put forth by the 'Translators', then all Skill Rewards for that auction goes to the 'Skill Reward Foundation' and will then be randomly given away at the end of each week to eligible users.
reward.translators_paragraph6: If there is not enough 'Skill Rewards' available for distribution for that particular listing, then we will give the eligible participants $0.01 from the Skill Reward Foundation.
reward.bidders_paragraph_heading1: Skill Reward Distribution Rules for Bidders
reward.bidders_paragraph_heading2: Collect Bidder Skill Rewards from Sealed Bid Auctions
reward.bidders_paragraph1: What is a 'Bidder' on the Bynfor platform? A 'Bidder' is a user who participates in any of the Bynfor auctions. Participating in an auction makes you a 'bidder'.
reward.bidders_paragraph2: Eligible bidders receive in total 2.8% of the winning bid amount as follows: The second highest bidder will receive 1.4% automatically. Other eligible bidders who are not the lowest bidder are eligible to collect Skill Rewards of 1.4% of winning bid amount (allocated randomly) as an additional membership benefit.
reward.bidders_paragraph3: Lowest Bidder is not eligible to grab the Bidder Skill Reward
reward.bidders_paragraph4: Winner is not eligible to grab the Bidder Skill Reward
reward.bidders_paragraph5: Seller is not eligible to grab the Bidder Skill Reward.
reward.bidders_paragraph6: If there is not enough 'Skill Rewards' available for distribution for that particular listing, then we will give the eligible participants $0.01 from the Skill Reward Foundation.
reward.friends_paragraph_heading1: Skill Reward Distribution Rules for Friends & Followers
reward.friends_paragraph_heading2: Collect Skill Rewards from Sealed Bid Auctions for Friends & Followers
reward.friends_paragraph1: You can also share your skill rewards with friends or followers. For exmaple, if you collect 'Skill Rewards' over $10, then you must share the amount above the $10 with three of your friends or followers. For example if Susie collects $15, then she can keep $10 but has to share $5 with three of her friends or followers.
reward.friends_paragraph2: Basically, 20% of the total reward amount that the participant has received from any of the Skill Reward types, will go to Friends or Followers (your Skill Reward must be more than $10.00 for this to be applicable).
reward.friends_paragraph3: Failure to share this diffence with three of your freinds within 12 hours means the 20% goes directly to the 'Skill Reward Foundation' automatically instead.

a_completed_transaction1: A completed transaction would not count as eligible to join the Skill Reward Party if the user does not have a valid membership before the completion of that purchase.
a_completed_transaction2: All valid membership users will have 3 forgivable chances total per year to redeem themselves from the canceled transactions and will still be able to join the Skill Reward Party as long as that user has at least another completed transaction within the same week. if_the_valid_membership: If the valid membership user has 3 or more transactions within the same past week, regardless of any transactions that got canceled within that same week, as long as the amount of the completed transactions is no less than 2, then the eligible use is still available to join both of the skill reward party on that same weekend. If the valid membership user only has one completed transaction for the same week’s record, then this user could only join one of the skill reward parties on that weekend.
if_the_valid_membership1: If the valid membership user has 2 completed transactions within the same past week, in a scenario when one of the completed transactions got canceled and this cancellation happened before the skill reward party, then that user could only join one of the skill reward parties on that weekend; if that cancellation happened after that user claimed skill reward from the skill reward party, then the higher skill reward amount that the user received from the skill reward party will be refunded back to the skill reward foundation. For this instance, when one valid membership user made 2 completed transactions within the same past week, and that user joined both skill reward parties on Saturday and Sunday which received 10 USD and 20 USD from those 2 skill reward parties, however, 1 of the transactions got canceled, then the higher skill reward amount which is the 20 USD in this particular case will be refunded back to the skill reward foundation.
if_the_valid_membership2: If the valid membership user has 2 completed transactions within the same past week, if both transactions got canceled after the skill reward parties, then both of the skill rewards that the user received from the skill reward parties will be refunded back to the skill reward foundation.
if_the_valid_membership3: If the valid membership user is a buyer/winning bidder or seller that received the skill reward from the Skill Reward Party that is more than the membership’s maximum winning skill reward amount, then that user will be able to receive the maximum winning skill reward amount plus the transaction amount that user made within in the same past week. For this instance, if that valid membership user has a Bronze membership with the maximum winning skill reward amount of $100 whom never claimed any other skill rewards before and also made one complete transaction of $1000 within the same past week, then this user could claim up to $100 + $1000 = $1100 for the first skill reward party within the same past week; if that user received more than $1100 in that skill reward party, then the exceeded amount will be transferred to the Skill Reward Foundation directly; if that user made another successfully transaction of $1 within the same past week, then the highest amount of transaction ($1000) would be applied for the first Skill Reward Party and the second highest amount of transaction ($1) would be applied for the second Skill Reward Party as long as there is remaining balance for that user’s membership; specifically, if that user received $99 from the first skill reward party within that same past week, then this user will also be able to join the second skill reward party and collect as much as the remining membership winning skill reward amount ($100-$99) plus the second highest transaction amount ($1) as $1 + $1 = $2 for this scenario.
if_the_valid_membership4: If the valid membership user who is a translator/estimator/commenter received the skill reward from the Skill Reward Party that is more than the membership’s maximum winning skill reward amount, then the exceeded amount will be transferred to the Skill Reward Foundation directly. For this instance, if that valid membership user has a Silver membership with the maximum winning skill reward amount of $1000 who also translated/estimated/commented in a completed auction within the same past week, in a scenario this user already grabbed and received a total of $500 from all previous Skill Rewards ($500 as usable Skill Reward not in the pending stage), then the maximum this user could receive from this particular Skill Reward Party will be $1000-$500 = $500; if this user grabbed $550 from the second Skill Reward Party within the same week, then $550 - $500 = $50 will be transferred directly to the Skill Reward Foundation and the new user would need to upgrade their membership in order to join and participate in other Skill Reward Party.
if_the_valid_membership5: A valid Membership User that is also the Second Highest Bidder would not be able to join the Skill Reward Party if that Second Highest Bidder is also the lowest bidder or the bidding price of that Second Highest Bidder is lower than the reserve price.

append_bidding_rule.bidder_eligibility1: If a bidder is the Second Highest Bidder in which that Second Highest Bidder’s bidding price has been used for a calculation for the winning payment amount, then that Second Highest Bidder will receive 1.2% of the Winning Bid Amount automatically, without clicking or claiming that Skill Reward.
append_bidding_rule.bidder_eligibility2: If the Second Highest Bidder is also the lowest Bidder but their bidding price is above the reserved price, then that Lowest Bidder would still be able to claim the reward as above as the Second Highest Bidder.
append_bidding_rule.bidder_eligibility3: If a bidder is neither a winning bidder nor the lowest bidder but has a valid membership, then that bidder would be able to claim a portion of 1.6% of the Winning Bid Amount allocated randomly upon clicking by any eligible bidder who has a valid membership.
append_bidding_rule.bidder_eligibility4: If a Second Highest Bidder’s bidding price is lower than the reserved price, and their bidding price is not used for a calculation of a winning payment amount, then that Second Highest Bidder is not eligible for any of that auction skill reward.
append_bidding_rule.bidder_eligibility5: If a bidder is the lowest bidder and their bidding price is not used for a calculation of a winning payment amount, then that bidder is not eligible for any auction skill reward.
append_bidding_rule.same_bid_price_content: In the event of the same bid price occurring during an auction from different bidders, Bynfor will determine who is the winner or who is the second-highest bidder based on the below rules & regulations.
append_bidding_rule.same_bid_price_content1: If both bidders don't have a valid Bynfor membership, then whoever bid earlier is the winner of that auction.
append_bidding_rule.same_bid_price_content2: If one of the bidders does have a valid Bynfor membership and the other one doesn't, then the bidder who has the valid Bynfor membership is the winner of that auction.
append_bidding_rule.same_bid_price_content3: If both bidders have valid Bynfor memberships, then whoever has a higher tier of the Bynfor membership is the winner of that auction.
append_bidding_rule.same_bid_price_content4: If both bidders have the same tier of the Bynfor membership and the memberships are both valid, then whoever registered their current Bynfor membership first is the winner of that auction (Note: current Bynfor membership means the most recent membership that you purchased, your registration time will be recounted whenever your membership expires without renewal, thus we strongly recommend that you renew it before expiration to maintain your first registration date.)
append_bidding_rule.same_bid_price_content5: If both bidders have the same tier of the Bynfor membership with the exact same Bynfor membership registration date, then whoever registered a Bynfor account first is the winner of that auction.

translation_eligibility_rule1: If a translator receives a 'LIKE' from a winning bidder, then that translator will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount automatically without clicking or claiming that Skill Reward
translation_eligibility_rule2: If a translator has a valid membership and receives at least one 'LIKE' from a bidder who is not a winning bidder nor the lowest bidder, then that translator will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount allocated randomly upon clicking by any eligible translator who has a valid membership.
estimator_eligibility_rule1: If an estimator receives a 'LIKE' from a winning bidder, then that estimator will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount automatically without clicking or claiming that Skill Reward.
estimator_eligibility_rule2: If an estimator’s estimated price is the closest to the final price after calculation (tax and shipping fee not included), then this estimator will be considered the Best Estimator and will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount automatically.
estimator_eligibility_rule3: An estimator who has the membership and receives at least a 'LIKE' from a bidder who is not a winning bidder nor a lowest bidder, the estimator will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount allocated randomly upon clicking by any eligible estimator.
commenter_eligibility_rule1: If a commenter receives a 'LIKE' from a winning bidder, then that commenter will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount automatically without clicking or claiming that Skill Reward.
commenter_eligibility_rule2: If a commenter has a valid membership and receives at least one 'LIKE' from a bidder who is not a winning bidder nor the lowest bidder, then that commenter will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount allocated randomly upon clicking by any eligible commenter who has a valid membership.
bidder_eligibility_rule1: If a bidder is the Second Highest Bidder in which that Second Highest Bidder’s bidding price has been used for a calculation for the winning payment amount; then that Second Highest Bidder will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount automatically without clicking or claiming that Skill Reward.
bidder_eligibility_rule2: If the Second Highest Bidder is also the lowest Bidder but their bidding price is above the reserved price, then that Lowest Bidder would still be able to claim the reward as above as the Second Highest Bidder.
bidder_eligibility_rule3: If a bidder is not a winning bidder nor the lowest bidder and has a valid membership, then that bidder will receive Skill Rewards from the Winning Bid Amount allocated randomly upon clicking by any eligible bidder who has a valid membership.
bidder_eligibility_rule4: If a Second Highest Bidder’s bidding price is lower than the reserved price and their bidding price is not used for a calculation of a winning payment amount, then that Second Highest Bidder is not eligible for any of that auction skill reward.
bidder_eligibility_rule5: If a bidder is the lowest bidder and their bidding price is not used for a calculation of a winning payment amount, then that bidder is not eligible for any auction skill reward.
participant_eligibility_rule1: If a bidder has a valid membership and is not the lowest bidder, then they are eligible for a random amount of skill rewards
participant_eligibility_rule2: If an estimator has a valid membership and receives at least a 'LIKE' from a bidder who is not the lowest bidder, then they are eligible for a random amount of skill rewards
participant_eligibility_rule3: If a translator has a valid membership and receives at least a 'LIKE' from a bidder who is not the lowest bidder, then they are eligible for a random amount of skill rewards
participant_eligibility_rule4: If a commenter has a valid membership and receives at least a 'LIKE' from a bidder who is not the lowest bidder, then they are eligible for a random amount of skill rewards
participant_eligibility_rule5: A winning bidder of an auction or A seller of an auction will also be eligible for a random amount of skill rewards
participant_eligibility_rule6: If a Second Highest bidder is also the lowest bidder, then that Second Highest Bidder will not be eligible to claim the Auction Participant Skill Reward.
participant_eligibility_rule7: All eligible participants need to click the 'claim' button to claim the Auction Participants Skill Reward.
participant_eligibility_rule8: For all participants, you may be eligible to receive Skill Rewards at random, once the auction ends you must view the auction results to see if you have received any Skill Rewards.
participant_eligibility_rule9: Among all the eligible participants who have a valid membership that joined the Auction Participants Skill Reward, Bynfor will randomly pick 1 lucky user to receive 0.6% of the Winning Bid Amount.
participant_eligibility_rule10: The rest of the eligible participants who have a valid membership will be able to receive a portion of 1.4% of the Winning Bid Amount allocated randomly upon clicking, that Skill Reward will be more than 1 USD but no more than 0.6% of the Winning Bid Amount.
participant_eligibility_rule11: If the 0.6% of the Winning Bid Amount is less than 1 USD, then that Auction Participant Skill Reward will not be available or not be held for this auction

information_For_Bynfor1: The Distributor feature allows a store to let other Bynfor Users sell their items and receive a commission based on the final price of the sale. There is an endless amount of distributors that can be allowed by the store owner. After signing up as a distributor for a store you will be a Level 1 distributor for that store. You can sign up to be a distributor for multiple stores.
information_For_Bynfor2: Bynfor allows sellers to set up commission levels for their distribution program. When setting up the commission structure, sellers can choose between three levels: level 1, level 2, or level 3. It's important to note that regardless of the chosen commission structure, sellers should not set their commission higher than 60% of the listing price.
information_For_Bynfor3: The commission will be based on the final price of the product after it is sold. This means that sellers will earn a percentage of the actual sale price as their commission, according to the chosen commission level.
information_For_Bynfor4: Bynfor provides this flexibility in commission levels to accommodate sellers' preferences and business strategies, while ensuring a fair and reasonable distribution system that benefits all parties involved.
information_For_Bynfor5: Please note: The seller is sharing the earned money from this item with the seller who made the sales. That amount will be given in a fixed amount or percentage. You can select which form of payment you want the distributor to receive, from the options of selecting 30% in Gift Cards and 70% in rewards or giving all the payment in rewards. A store can choose to give every user who sells for them the same amount of commission. To learn more about earning commission on products or as a store owner to allow users to help you make more sales for commission please follow the steps below. Please note that no matter your distributor level, only you and two distributors above your level will receive commission rewards. The commission feature allows a store to have users promote their products and receive a commission when those products sell. When listing their product, the commission percentage will be up to the store and how they set commission for their products. Store owners can set up to 3 levels of commission. Only three distributors will receive earnings after the product is sold and no return(or we may say ‘when the order is completed’). The user who made the sale will get commission level one. The person above that user will get commission level 2 and the person above that will get commission level 3.
information_For_Bynfor6: Bynfor provides users with the opportunity to earn money by promoting our other applications through the Partner Center. Here's how the program works:
information_For_Bynfor8: When you generate a sale for any of our software through the Partner Center, you will earn a commission based on a tiered structure.
information_For_Bynfor9: In the first year, you will earn a commission of 3% of the sale amount.
information_For_Bynfor10: In the second year, the commission rate will be 2%.
information_For_Bynfor11: In the third year, the commission rate will be 1%.
information_For_Bynfor13: Users who wish to sell our software as Bynfor Affiliates need to apply and be approved.
information_For_Bynfor14: Once approved, you can start finding potential buyers for the software.
information_For_Bynfor16: To initiate the purchase process, Bynfor Affiliates can generate a contract by clicking the "Generate Contract" button on the Partner Center.
information_For_Bynfor17: The generated contract should be sent to the potential buyer, who will need to review and agree to its terms.
information_For_Bynfor19: To proceed with the purchase, the buyer must create an account on Bynfor's platform.
information_For_Bynfor20: The buyer will then make the payment for the software contract through our platform.
information_For_Bynfor22: The user who successfully sells our software will receive their commission percentage through Bynfor's payment system.
information_For_Bynfor23: The commission amount earned will depend on the tiered structure and the successful completion of the sale.
information_For_Bynfor24: By participating in the Bynfor Affiliate program and promoting our software, users have the opportunity to earn commissions based on sales made through the Partner Center. The generated contracts and payments are handled through Bynfor's platform, ensuring a seamless and secure transaction process.
information_For_Bynfor25: How to be a Bynfor Affiliate
information_For_Bynfor26: Log in to your Bynfor account using your credentials.
information_For_Bynfor27: On the headers or main menu, locate and click on the "Partner Center" option. This will take you to the Affiliate program section.
information_For_Bynfor28: In the Partner Center, you will find a list of available contracts. Review the contracts and select the one that you wish to proceed with.
information_For_Bynfor29: Once you have selected a contract, you will be presented with different plan options. Choose the plan that best suits your preferences and goals as an affiliate.
information_For_Bynfor30: After selecting the desired plan, follow the prompts and instructions to create the contract. Provide any necessary information or details as requested.
information_For_Bynfor31: Review the contract details and ensure everything is accurate and to your satisfaction.
information_For_Bynfor32: Once you are ready, proceed to finalize the contract creation by confirming your agreement and accepting the terms and conditions.
information_For_Bynfor34: To refer a purchaser to a specific product on Bynfor, please follow these steps:
information_For_Bynfor35: Find the product that you want to refer to the purchaser. You can browse through the product listings or search for a specific item.
information_For_Bynfor36: Once you have found the product, click on it to view the details and additional information.
information_For_Bynfor37: On the product page, you should see an option to "Share" the product. Click on the share button, which will allow you to share the product with others.
information_For_Bynfor38: When sharing the product, you will have the option to add up to two referrals. Enter the username or store name of the person or store you want to refer.
information_For_Bynfor39: After adding the referrals, proceed with the purchase of the item. Click on the "Add to Cart" or similar button to add the product to your cart.
information_For_Bynfor40: Once you have finished adding all the desired items to your cart, proceed to the checkout process.
information_For_Bynfor41: Follow the steps provided during the checkout process, including entering the necessary shipping and payment information.
information_For_Bynfor42: Complete the checkout process and confirm your purchase.
information_For_Bynfor44: Bynfor offers a Merchant program that allows merchants to engage referrals and choose the commission rate they wish to offer. Here are the key details of the program:
information_For_Bynfor46: Merchants have the opportunity to allow referrals to refer buyers to their products.
information_For_Bynfor47: Both the merchant and the referrer will receive a base commission of 1% of the final sale price.
information_For_Bynfor49: In addition to the base commission, the merchant has the flexibility to provide an additional percentage of the final sale price to the referrer.
information_For_Bynfor50: This allows the merchant to incentivize referrals with a higher commission rate, varying for each item listed and for each individual referrer.
information_For_Bynfor52: The Merchant program allows merchants to have as many referrals as they desire.
information_For_Bynfor53: There is no limit on the number of referrals a merchant can engage.
information_For_Bynfor55: Merchants can change the commission percentage for each item listed, offering different rates to separate referrals.
information_For_Bynfor56: This customization allows merchants to tailor their commission structure based on specific arrangements with each referrer.
information_For_Bynfor57: The Merchant program empowers merchants to set commission rates for referrals, providing them with additional incentives beyond the base commission. This flexibility allows merchants to maximize the benefits of their referral program and build successful partnerships with referrers. It's important to note that specific terms and conditions may apply, so merchants are encouraged to review the program guidelines provided by Bynfor for further details and instructions on how to set up and manage their referral commissions.
information_For_Bynfor58: How to Accept a Store Referral or Product Referral
information_For_Bynfor59: To accept a store referral or product referral on Bynfor, please follow these steps:
information_For_Bynfor60: Log in to your Bynfor account using your credentials.
information_For_Bynfor61: Click on your username or avatar located in the top right corner of the page.
information_For_Bynfor62: From the dropdown menu, select the option "Affiliate Partnership" or a similar option that relates to referrals.
information_For_Bynfor63: On the Affiliate Partnership page, you should see a section for accepting referrals. This section will display any pending store or product referrals that have been sent to you.
information_For_Bynfor64: Review the details of the referral, including the store or product being referred.
information_For_Bynfor65: If you are satisfied with the referral, click on the appropriate button or link to accept it. This action will indicate your acceptance of the referral and initiate the referral partnership.
information_For_Bynfor66: If there are multiple referrals, and you are the primary referral, you may have the option to choose the percentage split between you and your partner. Select the desired percentage split if applicable.
information_For_Bynfor67: If there is a second primary referral, they will have a specified period of time, usually 72 hours, to accept or reject the referral. If the second primary referral does not respond within the given timeframe, the percentage split will be automatically determined without any exceptions.
information_For_Bynfor68: If the second primary referral rejects the referral, they will not receive any percentage, and the primary referral will receive 100% of the referral benefits.
information_For_Bynfor70: To become a Bynfor partner, please follow these steps:
information_For_Bynfor71: Click on your username located on the top right corner of the page.
information_For_Bynfor72: From the dropdown menu, select your username again.
information_For_Bynfor73: Click on "Bynfor Partnership" from the available options.
information_For_Bynfor74: Fill out the partnership form with the required information. This may include your personal details, business information, and any other relevant information.
information_For_Bynfor75: Once you have completed the form, click on the "Submit" button to send your "Become a Partner" application.
information_For_Bynfor76: Your application will be reviewed by the Bynfor Admin for consideration.
information_For_Bynfor77: Note: After you submit the "Become a partner" application, you don’t have to wait for the approval of an admin. You could immediately start to refer store owners to open the stores on Bynfor.
information_For_Bynfor78: Add a Partnership to your Store
information_For_Bynfor79: To register as a new user and become a Bynfor partner, please follow these steps:
information_For_Bynfor80: Start by registering as a new user on the Bynfor platform. Follow the registration steps provided.
information_For_Bynfor81: After successfully registering, you will see a pop-up window. Click on the "Become a Seller" option.
information_For_Bynfor82: Fill out the required in-store information, including details about your business, products, and other relevant information.
information_For_Bynfor83: In the "Refer" section, you can enter the username or store name of the person who referred you to become a partner. This step is optional.
information_For_Bynfor84: Once you have filled out the necessary information, click on the "Save" button to confirm and submit your store information.
information_For_Bynfor86: To confirm a partnership referral on Bynfor, please follow these steps:
information_For_Bynfor87: Click on your username located at the top right corner of the page.
information_For_Bynfor88: From the dropdown menu, click on your username again to access your account settings.
information_For_Bynfor89: Look for the "Bynfor Partnership" option and click on it. This will take you to the partnership settings page.
information_For_Bynfor90: Under the "References" section, you can manage your reference relationships.
information_For_Bynfor91: Review the list of references and their details. You can accept or reject partnership referrals based on your preference.
information_For_Bynfor92: If you wish to confirm a partnership referral, click on the appropriate option to accept and confirm the referral.
information_For_Bynfor93: Save your changes to update your partnership status.

notes_on_reverse_bids: Reverse Bid is an auction where sellers compete to offer the lowest price to win the buyer’s order. Unlike Sealed Bid, all participants can see the current leading bid and may continue to lower their prices in real time until the auction ends. Bynfor enhances this model by ensuring fair competition and transparent pricing dynamics, helping buyers gain cost efficiency while maintaining value for sellers.

By aligning your brand with the world of fine art, you not only tap into a discerning and culturally aware demographic but also harness the gallery's curated setting to convey a narrative that enhances your product's appeal. The gallery's visitors, drawn to the visual and emotional impact of art, are more likely to engage with your offering, making it a compelling platform to elevate your brand's presence and establish a meaningful connection with an audience that values the aesthetics and creativity your product embodies.
